description: This file defines the class Smarty_Internal_Method_GetTemplateVars, which provides methods to retrieve template variables within the Smarty templating engine, including fetching all variables, specific variables, and internal utility functions.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Method_GetTemplateVars
classes.description: A class providing methods for fetching template variables in Smarty, including getTemplateVars and internal variable retrieval functions.

methods.name: getTemplateVars
methods.description: Retrieves either a specific template variable value or all template variables available, optionally including parent templates and global variables.

methods.name: _getVariable
methods.description: Internal utility method to retrieve the Smarty variable object by name, optionally searching parent data and global variables, with an error handling flag.
